wiki_acceptance: #12: a sleeping pawn is visually distinct (dimmed) from a standing one.
summary: NEW SleepPoseDriver.cs only. Self-attaches via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] hidden persistent driver that periodically sweeps PawnMovement (pawn root) instances and EnsureOn-attaches exactly one SleepPoseDriver each — exact FlickerLight.cs / PawnFacing.cs driver + EnsureOn + 1.0s Time-throttled scan pattern (Time-in-Update throttle, NOT a WaitForSeconds heartbeat -> no bug-pattern #9 background-only timer). Per-frame reads sleep state via PawnNeeds.IsSleeping (the SAME public bool { get; private set; } PawnInfoPanel reads through pawn.GetComponent<PawnNeeds>(); PawnNeeds + PawnMovement + PawnEntity all colocated on the pawn root). When sleeping, eases the CHILD body SpriteRenderer.color toward awakeBase * dimTint(0.6/0.6/0.66 value, slight desaturate, alpha 1) so a sleeping pawn is clearly darker; restores exact awake base color when awake.
